_comment: Edit this file to change digest behaviour. Commit the change and the next run picks it up.
reader_profile: curious, science-literate general readers who are not specialists
_focus_comment: Leave subject_focus empty to rotate through focus_rotation daily. Set it to a specific topic (e.g. 'memory') to always search that topic.
_rotation_comment: 20 topics, each measured at 75+ articles over a 30-day window across the full journal list. See README 'Choosing topic wording' before adding one.
_ns_comment: ns_site_threshold: newscientist.com hits at or above which a study is dropped as already run there (lower than media_threshold since NS.com covering it is more disqualifying than a general outlet). ns_style_examples: how many real current NS.com headlines to pull as a style reference for the digest prompt.
